title: KITE: Retrieval as a Decision Procedure for Long-Term Conversational Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.41521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many long-term memory systems for LLM agents are built around embedding-based retrieval. Al- though effective for semantic matching, similarity ranking alone does not establish whether re- trieved memories satisfy the conditions implied by a question. In this paper, we introduce KITE (Knowledge-Indexed Temporal Evidence), a vector-free framework that formulates memory re- trieval as an explicit decision procedure. KITE organizes multi-session conversations as structured knowledge indexed by a governed topic vocabulary, which evolves through controlled expansion and consolidation. At query time, questions are compiled into inspectable retrieval plans over the same knowledge index that guides memory construction. The plans are then executed through fixed lookup and ranking operations, while sparse lexical retrieval recovers surface details omitted from the structured representation. translated_title: KITE：将检索作为长期对话记忆的决策程序
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体的许多长期记忆系统都是围绕基于嵌入的检索构建的。尽管这种方法对语义匹配有效，但仅凭相似度排序无法确定检索到的记忆是否满足问题所隐含的条件。本文提出了 KITE（Knowledge-Indexed Temporal Evidence，知识索引时序证据），这是一个无向量的框架，将记忆检索形式化为一个显式的决策程序。KITE 将多轮会话的对话组织为结构化知识，并通过一个受治理的主题词汇表进行索引，该词汇表通过受控的扩展与整合不断演化。在查询时，问题被编译为可在同一知识索引上进行检查的检索计划，以指导记忆的构建。这些计划随后通过固定的查找和排序操作来执行，同时稀疏词汇检索用于恢复结构化表示中遗漏的表层细节。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 数据集上的实验表明，KITE……
tldr: KITE 提出了一种无向量的长期对话记忆检索框架，将检索形式化为显式的决策程序，通过受治理的主题词汇表组织结构化对话知识，并将问题编译为可检查的检索计划，以验证检索到的记忆是否满足问题隐含的条件。
en_tdlr: KITE is a vector-free framework that formulates memory retrieval as an explicit decision procedure, organizing multi-session conversations into structured knowledge indexed by a governed topic vocabulary and compiling questions into inspectable retrieval plans to verify whether retrieved memories satisfy the conditions implied by the question.
